## Feature Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are requesting.

## Use Case / Problem Statement
Explain why this feature is beneficial and what limitation it addresses.
Example: "Custom key remapping from within the launcher UI would improve accessibility for arcade fight stick users."

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature being implemented or exposed to the user.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, technical references, or mockups here.
